rules.requirement: Any automatically created remediation branch must open its pull request back into the branch it was created from, not directly into master.
master may be the pull request base only when the remediation branch was created from master itself.
Before proposing any remediation merge, compare the origin branch, remediation branch, and master to prove that branch-specific commits are preserved.
Automated remediation must not push, merge, or publish directly with write permissions unless a separate reviewed policy explicitly allows it for the same origin branch.
